instruction: Synchronize only the landed Git-tracked code and configuration to the established SSH active checkout at /autodl-fs/data/OpenGU. Use ordinary non-force Git/SSH synchronization, preserve datasets, results, caches, environments and runtime evidence, and do not create or revive peer OpenGU directories under /autodl-fs/data.
preconditions: Confirm local HEAD equals landedTarget and the SSH alias autodl-opengu resolves through the operator's existing authorized SSH configuration.
Confirm /autodl-fs/data/OpenGU is the active checkout, no unexpected OpenGU peer deployment directory exists, and the remote checkout can advance without force or rebase.
readBack: Read back the remote active checkout HEAD and require it to equal landedTarget; then run the project's SSH deployment-layout and tracked retired-reference preflights against /autodl-fs/data and report their exact verdicts.
